sources: eval/drift_cases.py (18 dev cases, authored adversarial to token matchers)
eval/heldout_cases.py (16 held-out v2 cases, new domains, tests judge generalization)
provenance.honesty: Hand-authored cases, not real agent traces; the author also wrote the matcher. The trustworthy signals are the miss rate on paraphrase cases, the false-positive rate on traps, and generalization to held-out domains — not the headline %. Edge labels are the author's judgment call; a defensible judge could disagree.
provenance.measuredBaseline: Original Python harness (spring 2026): qwen3-vl-8b scored 18/18 dev + 16/16 held-out, 0 abstains. Live re-run through this TypeScript port (2026-08-17, same model via LM Studio): 32/34 accuracy with 17/17 violation recall (both misses are clean-trap false positives), 3 benign abstains; the exact original prompt format scored 33/34 in the same session, so ~1 case of drift is environmental. A/B detail: the shipped fenced format is the only variant preserving 100% violation recall.
